name: @codegraph/website-doc
description: Codegraph website: Hugo + Hextra. Builds when the hugo binary is on PATH; skips (with a notice) otherwise, so Node-only environments stay green.

scripts.build: if command -v hugo >/dev/null 2>&1; then hugo --minify --gc; else echo 'hugo not installed: website build skipped' >&2; fi
